title: BlockFront French translation
description: French translation of the BlockFront mod
body:
Complete translation of the [BlockFront](https://modrinth.com/mod/blockfront) mod into French.

Progress on translation: **35,01%** \
Come help with the translation: [HERE](https://github.com/WindowsCraft76/bf-french-translation)

**If you found a translation error or text that is poorly integrated into the game, or any other issue, please report it [here](https://github.com/WindowsCraft76/bf-french-translation/issues).**

### Use:
- Download the file
- Place it in the game's `resourcepacks`
 folder
- Set the game to French
- And that's it!


<details>

Traduction complète du mod [BlockFront](https://modrinth.com/mod/blockfront) en français.

Avancement de la traduction: **35,01%**

Contribuez à la traduction: [ICI](https://github.com/WindowsCraft76/bf-french-translation)

### Utilisation:

- Téléchargez le fichier
